Stage: Department Consult

Goals:
- produce a specialty opinion from the assigned department only;
- state the best department-specific lead diagnosis and the strongest competing alternative;
- recommend only the next tests that would change the decision;
- explicitly state whether cross-specialty escalation is needed.

Failure modes to avoid:
- broad, generic hospital summaries;
- drifting into unrelated specialties;
- recommending a large battery of low-value tests.
